title: Degree shifts between q-deformed friezes and q-Farey labelings for general triangulations
summary: Morier-Genoud and Ovsienko introduced q-deformations of continued fractions, Farey labelings, and Conway--Coxeter friezes, and established relationships among them in restricted settings associated with triangulations having exactly two exterior cells. In this paper, we extend these correspondences to arbitrary subsequences of quiddities arising from general triangulations.
